Name: Mieu's Sebastian Portrait
Author: mieulinhtu
Description:
[center]﻿
[list=1]
[*]Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/*]
[*]Put my mod folder in Mods\Portraiture\Portraits﻿[/*]
[*]Talk to Sebastian. Once the DialogueBox is open press P to change portraits till you see my folder's name. It will also shortly show the name of the folder above the left top corner of the DialogueBox, then press O to lock the portrait! [/*]
[/list][/center]
[center]===============================================================[/center]
[left][b]Update 1.1: [/b]I had been replaying the game again with new dialogues and everything, and decided to make changes to his happy expression to fit better to his gentler vibe.[/left]
[center][/center]
I had been playing Stardew Valley again. Someone had mentioned that I should make portrait mods for this game so I'm experimenting with Sebastian first since he was my husbando in this game LOOL. 
Looking around the mods on nexus made me wanted to try many things like animated portraits/seasonal outfits/etc... I will have to figure out how to make HD portrait with the animations, since there wasn't many portrait that higher than 64x64 that used those functions yet. I also don't know if Portraiture works for overworld sprites, I might play around with that in the future as well. 
Feel free to comment if there is a mod that you'd love me to work on for exclusive portraits, as long as it could support HD portraits.

So for now, please enjoy my vanilla edits of Sebastian portraits! I wanted more body movements for portrait, and adding some emo/goth accessories.

Sebastian's Winter outfits have two versions, one with the scarf, and one without.
You should be able to swap them with P key then lock the portrait with O; if not, just [b]go to the folder and delete the png of the version you don't want and change the name[/b]!
